name: Swift Reconfiguration
clause: Enchanted permanent is a Vehicle artifact with crew 5 and it loses all other card types.

needs.proposedSignature: `StaticEffect { kind: 'set-types', scope: 'enchanted' | 'equipped' | 'self' | 'you-control' | 'all', filter?: Filter, types?: CardType[], addTypes?: CardType[], subtypes?: string[], addSubtypes?: string[], loseOtherTypes?: true, abilities?: Ability[] }` — layer 4, applied in `computeStaticMods` next to the existing `set-pt` static
needs.semantics: "Enchanted permanent is a Vehicle artifact with crew 5 and it loses all other card types." is a continuous type-changing effect on an Aura: layer 4 sets the card types (Artifact only), adds the subtype Vehicle, and layer 6 grants the crew activated ability. The vocabulary has layer 7b (`set-pt` op and static) and layer 6 loss (`lose-abilities`) but nothing that writes TYPES, and the one-shot `animate` op cannot be an Aura's static ability. `abilities` on the same static is what carries "with crew 5" without needing a second declaration.
needs.clause: Enchanted permanent is a Vehicle artifact with crew 5 and it loses all other card types.
